name: Can I convert my bathtub into a shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my bathtub into a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting a bathtub into a shower is a common and popular renovation. This process involves removing the existing bathtub and replacing it with a new shower pan, wall surrounds, and fixtures. It's often done to create a more spacious or accessible shower area, especially for those who rarely use their tub. Tub-to-shower conversions can significantly update the look and functionality of a bathroom. We offer this service across Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, and Surprise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, converting a bathtub to a shower is common. It involves replacing the tub with a shower pan and fixtures to create a larger or more accessible shower.
